[[File:Ewoks_fishing.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] takes [[Wiley (Ewok)|Wiley]] and [[Nippet/Legends|Nippet]] fishing.]]
{{Quote|Hoop, huhp, Burl!|A [[Glurrg]] after being ordered to fish|<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
'''Fishing''' was a practice of gathering aquatic [[Fish/Legends|fish]] for [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] observed by many cultures and factions across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds" /> It was perhaps the most popular form of harvesting on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with large masses of [[Water/Legends|water]], such as [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds" /> the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]],<ref name="The Baby Ewoks' Picnic Surprise">''[[The Baby Ewoks' Picnic Surprise]]''</ref> and others. Most civilizations would use some variety of [[fishing pole]] or claw to gather the fish, but more primitive cultures, like the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], would use [[Glurrg]]s to dive in after the fish and catch them.<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds" />

Fishing was also one of the skills taught to [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] colonists on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] by [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] as means of gathering food in the wilderness. Fishing on a scale large enough to feed an entire colony could be conducted by [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]] harvesting shore fish or in deeper waters by [[utility trawler]]s.<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds" />
